quests.title: All Aboard!

icon.source: exact Unicorn Academy item model and locale

quests.description:
Look for a naturally generated Magical Ferry near Overworld beaches, rivers or oceans. Interact to board beneath open sky; wait for its wings and countdown. Sneak to dismount before departure. If it cannot find a safe dock, it refuses to fly. You do not need a crafted ferry. This is the optional travel lesson; entering the island another legitimate way can also start your adventure.

Quest task: read this travel guide and acknowledge it. This does not verify boarding.

quests.title: A Whole New Island

icon.source: exact Unicorn Academy item model and locale

quests.description:
Travel to Unicorn Island using a working native ferry, or another legitimate route. Record where you arrived and keep your return dock accessible. Find Academy Meadows, Skyberry Thickets or Unicorn Wildwood first. The island is intended to be accessible in Newbie, but a working return route must be confirmed before this chapter ships.

Quest task: be present in Unicorn Island. The task does not distinguish travel methods.
quests.hold: Effective Newbie dimension entry and safe return acceptance #742

quests.title: Meet the Herd

icon.source: exact Unicorn Academy item model and locale

quests.description:
Explore Academy Meadows, Ember Highlands, Skyberry Thickets, Unicorn Wildwood or Whispering Willows for wild unicorns. Their magic is hidden until your personal bond awakens. Choose a companion you like; you do not need a unicorn of every element. Spawn eggs are not a survival requirement. Unicorns do not breed; return to the wild herds if you want another.

Quest task: look directly at a unicorn so FTB can register an observation.

quests.title: A Friend of My Own

icon.source: exact Unicorn Academy item model and locale

criterion.source: Vanilla minecraft:tame_animal filtered to unicornacademy:unicorn; exact SWEM tameWithName trigger confirmed in Atlas; actual unicorn inheritance/credit test pending.

quests.description:
Approach a wild adult unicorn with an empty hand and mount it as with a SWEM horse; keep trying after being bucked off until it accepts you. Confirm tame status and ownership rather than assuming one ride is enough. From here, use the same unicorn for your bond milestones. Ordinary SWEM husbandry is covered in But I Want to Be a Horse Girl.

Quest task: the tame-animal advancement for a unicorn; this uses the native SWEM tame trigger, not a manual check.

quests.title: Open Your Heart
quests.description:
Sneak-interact with your tamed unicorn to open its inherited SWEM inventory. Search SWEM in JEI for bridle, blanket, saddle and girth strap; fit them in that order for safe steering and riding. While riding, open the Unicorn Screen (default B; check Controls > Unicorn Academy). This is your in-game reference: bond, magic energy, hoverable Powers and the Fairy Gemstone slot. Use it throughout the chapter; do not confuse SWEM affinity with magical bond.

Quest task: obtain the purple western saddle shown here (see its JEI recipe). Any compatible tack works for riding; the purple saddle is just the acquisition milestone. The task does not verify equipping.

quests.title: Brushing Up
quests.description:
Find the SWEM Brush recipe in JEI. Brush your unicorn while standing beside it; native bond gain is 10 with a 400-tick cooldown. SWEM grooming also has its own affinity limits. Care for your companion between rides; remove its bridle while it is resting so ordinary SWEM feeding is not blocked.

Quest task: obtain a SWEM Brush, not proof of brushing.

quests.title: A Berry Special Treat

icon.source: exact Unicorn Academy item model and locale

quests.description:
Find Sky Berry bushes in Academy Meadows, Skyberry Thickets and Unicorn Wildwood. Harvest mature bushes, replant berries and keep a renewable patch. Feed a berry to your unicorn: it heals 2 HP, restores a quarter of maximum magic energy and gives 16 bond XP when the feed cooldown permits. Ordinary feeding earns 8 bond XP per 200 ticks; berry restoration is separate from magical awakening. Keep ordinary SWEM food and water available too.

Quest task: acquire Sky Berries, not proof of feeding.

quests.title: Happy Trails

criterion.label: Read the riding and bond guide

quests.description:
Ride your equipped unicorn across safe terrain and explore new chunks. Native magical bond gains 2 XP per 16 ridden blocks and 5 for a newly ridden chunk. Ride, brush and feed over time; inspect your own bond in the Unicorn Screen. Native training and magical bond are separate systems.

Guide acknowledgement only. FTB does not verify ridden distance or bond XP.

quests.title: The Magic Awakens

icon.source: exact Unicorn Academy item model and locale

criterion.label: Read the bond level 5 awakening guide

quests.description:
Grow the bond with one unicorn to level 5. Each next level costs 50 times the next level; 750 total XP reaches awakening. The horn and bond markings reveal its element and powers. Energy is normally 100 maximum and regenerates 2 per second after awakening. The displayed unlock levels matter: wild unicorns receive their own random subset of abilities and schedules.

Guide acknowledgement only: check your own bond in the Unicorn Screen; the quest itself does not verify level 5 or unlock magic.

quests.title: My First Magic

criterion.label: Read the casting controls and practice guide

quests.description:
Mount your awakened unicorn. In Controls > Unicorn Academy, bind Cycle Unicorn Magic (default R) and Use Unicorn Magic (default V); B opens the Unicorn Screen. Cycle to a power listed as unlocked, aim at a suitable safe target, cast and watch the energy and cooldown. A refused cast is not success. Some sustained abilities toggle off with a second cast. Practice the power your unicorn actually knows; no specific element is required.

Guide acknowledgement only; FTB does not verify a successful cast.

quests.title: A Little Light
quests.description:
Optional light route. Read Powers in the Unicorn Screen for your unicorn's actual unlocks. Use Guiding Light for temporary illumination, Light Flash or Focused Flash for hostile targets, and Rainbow Light Bridge to aim at a destination from above then ride the temporary arc. Light Shield absorbs a finite number of hits; Rainbow Vision reveals nearby treasures and tracks; Rainbow Starfall damages hostiles and gives nearby allies buffs. Try any one unlocked light spell; do not collect all seven. Longer bridges cost more and expire.

Optional guide acknowledgement; no cast or specific unicorn element is verified.

quests.title: Green Magic
quests.description:
Optional plant route. Use Plant Growth on a suitable crop or sapling to accelerate growth; Vine Manipulation can hold an enemy or move an eligible item or small animal. Plant Resizing grows selected plants or removes eligible obstacles, Vine Barrier makes a temporary wall, and All-Seeing Butterfly provides temporary remote scouting. Check Powers for the actual unlock schedule. Use one unlocked plant spell on your own land; temporary constructs are not harvested materials.

Optional guide acknowledgement; no cast or specific unicorn element is verified.

quests.title: Let It Snow
quests.description:
Optional ice route. Ground Freeze frosts water and ground, Ice and Snow Blast slows a target, Ice Wall creates temporary protection, and Ice Trail makes a temporary rideable path over gaps and water. Cold, rain and night affect the trail's lifespan. Time Freeze immobilizes eligible creatures, not global time or bosses. Read your Powers and try any one unlocked ice spell; keep clear of other players' structures.

Optional guide acknowledgement; no cast or specific unicorn element is verified.

quests.title: Under the Sea
quests.description:
Optional water route. Water Creation makes temporary terrain water and can fill an empty bucket or glass bottle held in hand; Water Manipulation gathers an orb, then throws it on another cast or attack. Water Shield absorbs limited hits. Air Bubble refills air and grants Water Breathing while active; look up or down to rise or dive. Read the Powers list and practice any one unlocked water spell safely, away from valuable builds.

Optional guide acknowledgement; no cast or specific unicorn element is verified.

quests.title: Some Like It Hot
quests.description:
Optional fire route. Fireball burns enemies, Red-Hot Hooves melts and scorches, Wall of Fire repels enemies, Pillar of Fire launches them, and Super Fiery Speed boosts movement while active. Read your unicorn's Powers for actual unlocks. Practice any one unlocked fire spell in a clear safe area; do not use destructive effects near friends or fragile buildings. Toggle sustained magic off when finished.

Optional guide acknowledgement; no cast or specific unicorn element is verified.

quests.title: Riding the Storm
quests.description:
Optional weather route. Thunder and Lightning strikes a target, Weather Manipulation summons a local cloud, Miniature Tornado moves enemies and items, and Thunder Shockwave stuns nearby hostiles. Flying Lightning gives temporary mounted flight; look up or down to climb or dive and land before the effect ends. This is not permanent weather control. Read Powers and try one unlocked weather spell in a safe space.

Optional guide acknowledgement; no cast or specific unicorn element is verified.

quests.title: A Bond Beyond Words
quests.description:
Keep riding, grooming and feeding until your own bond with a unicorn reaches level 8, normally 1800 total XP. Additional powers may unlock on the way; their cost falls by 4% per level beyond the assigned unlock up to a 25% discount, and power increases. This is the native Fairy Gemstone equipment threshold. You do not need all six elements.

Guide acknowledgement only: the native gemstone slot enforces bond 8, not this quest.

quests.title: A Spark of Fairy Magic

icon.source: exact Unicorn Academy item model and locale

quests.description:
The Fairy Gemstone belongs in the dedicated slot in the Unicorn Screen. It grants wings while equipped; it is recoverable equipment rather than a permanent consumed unlock. The pinned mod has no established survival recipe or loot route, so this optional acquisition quest is held until TMM establishes a legitimate source. Do not use Creative or commands to obtain it for progression.

Quest task: obtain the actual gemstone. The acquisition route remains a tracked pack-design blocker; this branch is optional and does not gate the capstone.
quests.hold: Owner decision and actual legal survival acquisition required; no gemstone reward or new recipe authorized

quests.title: Spread Your Wings
quests.description:
At bond 8 or higher, open the Unicorn Screen and equip the Fairy Gemstone in its own slot. Bind Fairy Wings (default Y) to deploy or retract; bind SWEM Flight (default J) to take off, Space rises and Shift dives. Practice close to the ground, land safely, and keep your gemstone. Retracting wings in flight gives brief Slow Falling, not permanent immunity. Separate inherited SWEM armor-based flight is taught in the horse chapter; it does not prove fairy-wing flight.

Guide acknowledgement only; actual wings and flight are not verified. The native equipment requirements still apply.
quests.hold: Requires approved gemstone route, effective mounted flight and actual detector

quests.title: Friends Forever
quests.description:
Reach the maximum personal bond of 10 with a unicorn: normally 2750 total XP. Continue your care and exploration, use the Unicorn Screen to see every power your friend has unlocked, and enjoy its strongest abilities. Wild unicorns can have different power sets. Fairy wings and element demonstrations are optional branches, not requirements for this capstone. Your native bond grows even when global Newbie MXP stays zero.

Guide acknowledgement only: read your own bond in the Unicorn Screen. FTB does not certify level 10.

quests.title: Homeward Bound

icon.source: exact Unicorn Academy item model and locale

quests.description:
Return to the paired ferry dock you arrived at, board beneath open sky and wait for safe destination preparation. Record the route home. The island-side generation and safe return path require pack verification; do not assume a loose ferry item is obtainable. Before bringing your unicorn across dimensions, check the verified transport route in the next horse chapter. This optional lesson is held until the route works for Newbie players.

Optional return guide acknowledgement, not a verified successful crossing. Return availability is a separate pack QA requirement.
quests.hold: Safe island-side ferry and Newbie travel acceptance
